answerCheck.derivedAnswer: D. The secant line through the two endpoints.
answerCheck.reason: The secant through (a,f(a)) and (b,f(b)) has slope (f(b)-f(a))/(b-a), exactly the average rate of change.
Here f(4)=9 and f(0)=1, so the average rate is (9-1)/(4-0)=2.
Each interval lasts one hour, so its average speed equals its increase in distance divided by 1 hour. The graph shows the largest such increase between t=1 and t=2.
